# semaphore_ex_app (Data Source)

Manages a custom task application. The executable path and arguments describe the command installed on runners; configuring an app does not execute it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "semaphore_ex_app" "custom" {
  id = "custom_tool"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Stable custom application identifier. Use letters, digits and underscores, as required by the server option keys.

### Read-Only

- `active` (Boolean) Makes the app available for task templates.
- `args` (List of String) Command arguments supplied to the application.
- `color` (String) Light-theme icon color.
- `dark_color` (String) Dark-theme icon color.
- `icon` (String) Icon identifier.
- `path` (String) Executable path on the runner.
- `priority` (Number) Display ordering priority.
- `title` (String) Display title.
